battleAbility_suitDesc1_10000.ch: 若没有装备其它套装心法，则自身伤害提升10%，受到伤害-10%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10000.en: If no other set Mind Skill is equipped, Damage Done +10%, Damage Taken -10%.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10001.ch: 若装备的心法数量小于8，则体力上限+20%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10001.en: If less than 8 Mind Skills are equipped, Max Vitality +20%.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10002.ch: 若没有装备其它红色心法，则获得3%的体力和灵力偷取。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10002.en: If no other Mythic Mind Skill is equipped, gain 3% Vitality Steal and Energy Steal.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10004.ch: 心情低落惩罚降低50%，心情低落过月时，有50%概率获得1点任意资质。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10004.en: Low Mood penalty -50%. There is a 50% chance to acquire 1 random Stat when in Low Mood at monthly summary.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10005.ch: 月结后最大体力和最大灵力恢复40%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10005.en: Max Vitality and Max Energy recover by 40% after monthly summary.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10007.en: Obtain 50% more Spirit Stones when selling items.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10008.ch: 对怪物造成伤害时，有概率掉落灵石。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10008.en: Dealing damage to monsters has a certain chance to drop Spirit Stones.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10010.ch: 将10%的防御力转换为攻击力。

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10011.ch: 若你装备了范围型剑法绝技，则在剑系身法持续时间，每5秒自动施放一次当前装备着的绝技。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10011.en: If you are equipped with an AoE Sword Special Skill, it is auto cast once every 5s for the duration of a sword Motion Skill.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10012.ch: 每次释放剑系武技会有&8036001_jqgl&%概率对最近目标施放一道极快的追踪斩龙剑气造成&8036001_jqwl&威力的伤害。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10012.en: Every time you cast a Sword Martial Skill, you will have a &8036001_jqgl&% chance to release an enemy-tracking Dragonslayer Sword Aura toward the nearest target, dealing &8036001_jqwl& damage.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10013.ch: 大幅提升狂血斩加的范围和伤害，且每使用一次狂血斩，神通时间持续时间增加5秒，最多可增加30秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10013.en: Greatly increase the area and damage increase of Crazeblood Cleave. Each use of Crazeblood Cleave increases Ultimate Skill duration by 5s, up to 30s.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10014.ch: 刀系武技造成伤害后，增加邪刃数量+1，最大叠加20层。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10014.en: After Blade Martial Skills deal damage, the amount of Felblade is increased by 1. Stackable at max 20 times.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10015.ch: 鬼狱枪的范围和数量变为3倍。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10015.en: Hellspear area and quantity are tripled.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10016.ch: 使用枪系身法会召唤一个免疫一切伤害且随自身释放枪系绝技的幻象，持续30秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10016.en: Casting a Spear Motion Skill summons an invincible phantom for 30s that can imitate your Spear Special Skills upon casting them.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10017.ch: 当震天拳使敌人晕眩后，在10秒内，震天拳的蓄力时间降低为0.1秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10017.en: During the 10s after Colossal Fist stuns an enemy, Colossal Fist charging time is reduced to 0.1s.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10018.ch: 若你拥有护盾，则每次使用裂地拳时，会消耗10%的护盾（且最大不超过5000），每消耗100点护盾可提升裂地拳的范围和伤害。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10018.en: If you have a shield, casting Seismic Fist consumes 10% of the shield (up to 5000). Every 100 Shield consumed increases the area and damage of Seismic Fist.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10019.ch: 战斗中生成10次掌风后，后续生成的掌风将变更为超级掌风。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10019.en: After generating Palm Wind 10 times in a battle, Palm Wind to be generated becomes Super Palm Wind.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10020.ch: 暴风掌射程翻倍，且在范围内自动索敌。掌身法持续期间，每次施放暴风掌都会使暴风掌伤害提高5%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10020.en: Storm Palm range is doubled, and it tracks enemies automatically within range. Each cast of Storm Palm increases Storm Palm damage by 5% for the duration of a Palm Motion Skill.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10021.ch: 每使用1次指法绝技，有25%的概率升级轮回指，最多可升到3级。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10021.en: Each cast of a Finger Special Skill has a 25% chance to upgrade Boomerang Finger, up to Rank 3.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10022.ch: 在隐身状态下使用灵影指，可使本次灵影指的持续时间变为5倍。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10022.en: Shadowy Finger cast while invisible lasts 5 times longer.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10023.ch: 在召唤花妖后时，会立即对场上所有小花妖进行一次随机强化效果。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10023.en: When summoning Flower Faerie Queen, all Small Flower Faeries present are enhanced randomly once.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10024.ch: 毒株术会在进行攻击时额外攻击2次，且毒株术造成伤害后为敌方添加1层脆弱效果，每层效果使毒刺伤害提高5%，最大提高125%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10024.en: Poisonous Plants deal 2 additional attacks. After dealing damage to enemies, Poisonous Plants apply 1 x Feeble on them. Each stack of Feeble increases the damage from Poisonous Thorn by 5%, up to 125%.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10025.ch: 冰气术造成伤害时，降低水身法冷却2秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10025.en: When Icy Aura deals damage, Water Motion Skill cooldown is reduced by 2s.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10026.ch: 当灵力大于50%时，灵流术每秒会消耗0.25%的最大灵力，强化使其能穿透，且伤害提升100%
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10026.en: When you have more than 50% Energy, Spiritual Torrent consumes 0.25% Max Energy per sec to gain enhanced penetrative missiles, and deal 100% more damage.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10027.ch: 焰火术每次造成暴击伤害时，可降低下次离火术的生成间隔10%，最大降低50%。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10027.en: Each time Fire Flare triggers Crit, the generation interval of the next Fire Sorrow is reduced by 10%, up to 50%.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10028.ch: 业火术透支时每秒会消耗自身5%的最大体力，并提升其伤害和射程。透支时间不再限制。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10028.en: During the extension of Sinful Flame, it consumes 5% Max Vitality per sec to gain increased damage and range. There is no longer a time limit to the extension.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10029.ch: 当你体力大于70%时，飞沙术的持续施法时间翻倍。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10029.en: At 70% or higher Vitality, Sandstorm duration is doubled.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10030.ch: 若携带了风刃术时，狂风术持续施法超过3秒时，会在原地生成一个持续7秒的固定狂风术。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10030.en: When you are equipped with Wind Edge, after Wild Wind is cast for 3s, a rooted Wild Wind will be generated on its location for 7s.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10031.ch: 增加聚石阵的范围和数量。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10031.en: Rock Formation area and quantity are increased.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10032.ch: 当场上存在3个及以上的土傀儡时（包括超级土傀儡），获得效果：每秒随机在一个土傀儡的位置产生一次震爆。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10032.en: After there are 3 or more Earth Golems (including Advanced Earth Golems) exist on the battlefield, one blast is triggered at the position of a random Earth Golem per sec.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10033.ch: 使用雷系身法后，可获得一次闪避效果，不可叠加。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10033.en: After casting a Lightning Motion Skill, you gain a dodge attempt. This effect cannot stack.

battleAbility_suitDesc1_10034.ch: 每次使用雷系绝技时，可召唤一只雷兽，场上最多可存在5只雷兽。
battleAbility_suitDesc1_10034.en: Casting a Lightning Special Skill summons a Lightning Beast. There can be at most 5 Lightning Beasts at a time.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10011.ch: 剑系的范围类绝技的范围增加50%，在施放剑系的范围类绝技时，会随机在一个敌人的位置额外施放一次。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10011.en: Sword AoE Special Skill area is increased by 50%. When casting a sword AoE Special Skill, it is cast an extra time at the position of a random enemy.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10012.ch: 斩龙剑气造成超过&8036001_shcs&次伤害后，下一次绝影剑剑影数量+&8036001_ddsl&。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10012.en: After your Dragonslayer Sword Aura deals &8036001_shcs& times of damage, the amount of Sword Shadows of your next Shadowless Sword +&8036001_ddsl&.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10013.ch: 霸道斩改为不跟随自身，而是改为自动寻敌。并且旋转时间越久伤害越高。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10013.en: Overbearing Cleave tracks enemies automatically instead of following you. The longer it spins, the higher its damage.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10014.ch: 邪刃在达到最远距离后会变更追踪刀刃再次进行攻击。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10014.en: After reaching the farthest point, Felblade changes its tracking blade to attack again.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10015.ch: 鬼狱枪每造成一次伤害，碎玉枪的CD-0.1秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10015.en: Each time Hellspear deals damage, Crackling Jade Spear cooldown -0.1s.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10016.ch: 场上每有一个幻像，枪系武技的攻击数量+1。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10016.en: For every phantom present, Spear Martial Skill's attack attempts +1.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10017.ch: 金刚拳持续期间，每次释放震天拳会额外使所有盾影进行爆发。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10017.en: For the duration of Ironbody Fist, each Colossal Fist triggers the burst of all Shield Shadows additionally.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10018.ch: 轰天拳不再消耗护盾打出额外攻击次数，转而每次造成伤害时会获得50点护盾。且每100点最大体力提高20点护盾上限。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10018.en: Skyblast Fist no longer costs Shield for additional attacks but grants 50 Shield whenever it deals damage. Every 100 Max Vitality increases Max Shield by 20.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10019.ch: 每生成1个超级掌风，下次使用惊虹掌时将额外增加1道掌印，最多可增加30道。惊虹掌改为自动索敌。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10019.en: For every 1 Super Palm Wind generated, the next Rainbow Palm drops 1 extra Palm Mark, up to 30. Rainbow Palm now tracks enemies automatically.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10020.ch: 身法持续期间，暴风掌冷却锁定为2秒。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10020.en: For the duration of a Motion Skill, Storm Palm cooldown is fixed at 2s.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10021.ch: 轮回指可升级到5级，且当达到5级后，自身的神通冷却降低50%。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10021.en: Boomerang Finger can now be upgraded to Rank 5. At Rank 5, your Ultimate Skill cooldown -50%.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10022.ch: 在持续施放灵影指时，每秒提高灵影指的范围和威力，最大可提升至300%的威力。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10022.en: While casting Shadowy Finger, its area and Power increases every second to up to 300% Power.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10023.ch: 花妖后每2秒会随机对一个小花妖施加一个随机的强化效果。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10023.en: Flower Faerie Queen casts a random enhancement to a random Small Flower Faerie every 2s.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10024.ch: 毒刺每次对单位造成的伤害都会被永久地记录起来，该单位在受到木系神通伤害时候触发一次这个伤害。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10024.en: Any damage dealt to a unit by Poisonous Thorn will be recorded. When the unit takes damage from Wood Ultimate Skill, damage equal to the recorded amount will be dealt additionally.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10025.ch: 当你装备了冰气术时，你的水分身也可以使用冰气术（但是不会生成爆灵湖）。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10025.en: When you are equipped with Icy Aura, your water clone can also cast Icy Aura (but it won't generate Energy Pond).

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10026.ch: 每当自身消耗了1%的灵力，在下次使用右键时，将发射一根可穿透的冰柱，对敌人造成伤害和冰冻。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10026.en: For every 1% Energy consumed, the next RMB shoots a penetrative icicle to deal damage and freeze the enemy.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10027.ch: 离火术每透支1秒，则本场战斗中其冷却时间-3%，最多可减60%。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10027.en: For every 1s Fire Sorrow is extended, its cooldown in this battle -3%, up to -60%.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10028.ch: 结束业火术时，透支消耗的体力会逐渐恢复。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10028.en: After Sinful Flame finishes, the Vitality consumed by the extension is restored over time.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10029.ch: 飞沙术会根据与单位距离提升伤害，最大距离800码时提升100%伤害。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10029.en: Sandstorm deals higher damage to enemies farther away, up to 100% more to enemies 800 away.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10030.ch: 若携带了风刃术时，后续生成的固定狂风术会向随机方向释放15个风刃术。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10030.en: When you are equipped with Wind Edge, rooted Wild Wind generated afterwards will cast 15 Wind Edges at a random position.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10031.ch: 聚石阵在结束后，会引爆其生成的土傀儡，造成大量伤害（伤害与土傀儡的体力相关）。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10031.en: After Rock Formation finishes, it detonates the Earth Golem it has summoned to deal huge damage (in proportion to Earth Golem Vitality).

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10032.ch: 在战斗中累计召唤了5个土傀儡后，本场战斗中，后续召唤土傀儡将改为召唤超级土傀儡。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10032.en: After summoning 5 Earth Golems, Earth Golems to be generated become Advanced Earth Golems until the end of battle.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10033.ch: 在雷系神通持续时间内，雷系身法的冷却时间-80%。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10033.en: Lightning Motion Skill cooldown -80% for the duration of a Lightning Ultimate Skill.

battleAbility_suitDesc2_10034.ch: 雷兽在死亡时，会立即施放一次你的雷系绝技，伤害为原来的30%。
battleAbility_suitDesc2_10034.en: When a Lightning Beast dies, it casts your Lightning Special Skill at 30% damage.
